summary: Model card for Gemini 2.5 Computer Use, a Gemini 2.5 Pro derivative post-trained for browser UI control. Reports web/mobile agent benchmarks (including Browserbase-measured results), relies on Gemini 2.5 Pro for ethics & safety evals, and describes agent-specific risks (prompt injection, unintended irreversible actions) and mitigations such as user confirmations and an inference-time safety monitor. Declared out of scope for FSF assessment.

framework.name: Frontier Safety Framework
framework.level_or_determination: Not in scope for FSF assessment
framework.quote: it is therefore not in scope for a Frontier Safety Framework assessment.

harmful_content_refusal.finding: No model-specific safety results; relies on Gemini 2.5 Pro evaluations.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: As the Gemini 2.5 Computer Use Model is based off of Gemini 2.5 Pro, we rely on Ethics & Safety evaluations reported for Gemini 2.5 Pro.

jailbreak_robustness.quote: deliberately trying to spot weaknesses and ensure the model adheres to safety policies and desired outcomes

prompt_injection.finding: Prompt injection via adversarial website content identified as a key risk category; no eval results reported.
prompt_injection.quote: Intentional adversarial misuse** of the model, for example through prompt injection tactics, where adversarial instructions are embedded in websites.

privacy.finding: Risk of data exfiltration and release of sensitive/personal content named; user confirmation needed to access health/financial records.
privacy.quote: This can lead to failed tasks or data exfiltration.

system_safeguards.finding: Describes post-training to recognize high-stakes actions, inference-time safety monitor that blocks prohibited actions and requires user confirmation, site blocking, and input/output guardrails.
system_safeguards.quote: implementing a safety monitoring and filtering system that observes model actions

other_safety.finding: Unintentional agentic failure modes (irreversible harmful actions, misinterpreting goals) named as risk category.
other_safety.quote: where the model takes an irreversible action that could harm a user.

self_reported_limitations.text: Computer use evaluations are sensitive to agent environment and system instructions.
Not yet optimized for OS-level or mobile control.

notes: Agentic-safety section is descriptive (risks + mitigations) with no quantitative prompt-injection evaluation.
